title: Quantitative stability for Bakry--Émery log-Sobolev and Talagrand inequalities
summary: We establish quantitative $L^1$-stability estimates for the Bakry--Émery log-Sobolev and Talagrand inequalities with a universal exponent of 1/19 governing the corresponding deficits. Our approach relies on a Maurey-type argument combined with stability estimates for the Prékopa--Leindler inequality. In the radial setting, the exponent of both deficits can be improved to $1/2,$ which turns out to be optimal.
